note.en: Authored offline city posters of central Paris, baked from OpenStreetMap: the street map (about 9,400 street lines, the Seine, parks, railways, three marks), a skyline from mapped building heights, a food map of mapped places to eat and drink, and four landmark outlines, with five themes, three formats, a round art area, print PNG export and a deterministic 60-second film. Every line, height and place is a mapped feature; skyline heights are stretched to fit. Silent by design; no runtime model calls.
note.zh-CN: 原创离线城市海报，示例为从 OpenStreetMap 烘焙的巴黎市中心：街道地图（约 9400 条街道线、塞纳河、公园、铁路和三个标记）、按登记建筑高度画出的天际线、登记餐饮地点的美食地图和四张地标轮廓，有五个主题、三种尺寸、圆形画面、打印 PNG 导出和可确定重放的 60 秒影片。每一条线、每个高度和地点都是地图上的真实要素；天际线高度按比例拉伸。设计上无声音，运行时不调用模型。
